WAM::disable
Description
Disables the WAM/AAM plugin for the current TCP connection. WAM/AAM
will remain disabled on the current TCP connection until it is closed
or
WAM::enable
is called.
See this KB article for more details:
https://support.f5.com/csp/article/K52245924
Syntax
WAM
::
disable
WAM::disable
Disables plugin processing for the duration of the TCP connection or
until
WAM::enable
is called.
Note: WAM::disable deprecates
PLUGIN::disable
WAM
Examples
# Disable WAM for HTTP paths ending in .php
when
HTTP_CLASS_SELECTED
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
path
]
ends_with
".php"
}
{
WAM
::
disable
}
else
{
WAM
::
enable
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_CLASS_SELECTED
